_comment: Third-party contents of every WebAssembly engine the site serves, for the generated notices at /licenses/ (scripts/sbom/notices.ts, run by the production build). One entry per bundle in public/wasm/wasm-provenance.json and src/data/sbomWasmArtifacts.json; the build fails if a bundle has no entry, an entry names a bundle that is not served, or a text file is missing. Rust crates are not typed here: they are read from the binaries at build time and their licence files come from crateLicenseTexts.json. `texts` are files in ./texts/, copied verbatim from the upstream source named in `textSources`. `incomplete` says what these notices do not yet cover; the engine repositories will ship their own notices.

textSources.softhsmv3-LICENSE.txt: pqctoday-org/pqctoday-hsm LICENSE at 496f9e529d3d92248dc414e153b06afca8d3ff4f (SoftHSMv3 header followed by the original SoftHSM2 licence)
